nom: St Ives Gentle Apricot Facial Scrub 150Ml

avis.texte: I've been using St Ives Gentle Apricot Facial Scrub for 15 years. I can never find this exact formula in stores anymore. All the other stuff irritates my skin. This one is the best and only one I'll ever use. Makes my skin so soft! Best once a week scrub. Please never change it. It would be even better if it came in a tub instead of a tube as I have to cut the tube open to get out all of the product.
I enjoy using Saint Ives facial scrub - it cleanses my face and removes dead skin cells along with oily grime and pollutants.
Makes my skin smoother and softer, helps with my acne in a couple days
I am 58 year old who loves using this product. It's not just for blemishes. It doesn't dry me out.
Outstanding product, can really feel it exfoliating, Easily the best on the market in my opinion.
Mi piace che posso controllare la densità con appena bagnarmi le mani, l’uso per la faccia da tanto tempo e mi trovo benissimo. Consigliato
It fades your blemishes leaving you with a clearer and smoother skin works like magic
I love the exfoliating apricot so I knew the blemish control would be of high quality as well. Smells nice. Great face wash for stubborn acne. I have sensitive skin and this brand is great.
